description: Link an existing external ticket or GitHub pull request to a Sentry issue by URL: Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, or an installed Sentry App such as Linear. Adds a reference only; it does not create the ticket or change the issue status (use update_issue).

appSlug.description: Installed Sentry App slug. Inferred for Linear and Shortcut URLs; specify it for other Apps.

externalIssueUrl.description: URL of the existing external ticket or GitHub pull request. For Sentry Apps, the canonical issue URL from the provider.

fields.description: Extra form values by field name, for a Sentry App that requires them.

integrationId.description: Native integration ID, only needed when multiple installations match the URL.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: link_issue
title: Link Issue
